description: This file defines the 'Login' React component which provides a frontend-only login interface. It manages user input for email and password, sets an authentication flag in storage, and navigates to the dashboard upon submission. It does not interact with a backend.

methods.name: Login
methods.description: React functional component rendering a login form with branding, email, and password fields, handling form submission to set authentication state and navigate.

methods.name: onSubmit
methods.description: Handles form submission: prevents default behavior, sets auth state, stores user info in localStorage, and navigates to dashboard.
